title: Analyzing dysregulation of the eIF4F complex in human cancers using R
author: Wu, Wagner

steps.title: Install R and RStudio
steps.instruction: Download and install R version 4.2.1 and RStudio from https://www.rstudio.com/products/rstudio/download/ if they are not already present on the system.

steps.title: Install dependent R packages
steps.instruction: In RStudio, install Bioconductor version 3.15, then install the required packages listed in the variable bio_pkgs, and load them. Use install.packages() for any non‑Bioconductor packages that are required.

substeps.instruction: lapply(bio_pkgs, require, character.only = TRUE)   # load packages

steps.title: Install eIF4F.analysis package
steps.instruction: Install the development version of the eIF4F.analysis package from GitHub and load it in the R session.

steps.title: Clone repository and set up directories
steps.instruction: Open a terminal, clone the GitHub repository, and verify that the scripts and default data/output directories are created under the home directory as ~/eIF4F.analysis.

substeps.instruction: Check that ~/eIF4F.analysis/Script contains Download.R and Analysis.R, that ~/eIF4F.analysis/eIF4F_data and ~/eIF4F.analysis/eIF4F_output will be created later, and that subfolders under R and eIF4F_output will be generated by the package.

steps.title: Verify script directory variables
steps.instruction: Open Download.R in RStudio and confirm that the default directories for data download and output storage are set to the environment variables shown (output_directory defaults to ~/eIF4F.analysis/eIF4F_output).

steps.title: Download all datasets
steps.instruction: Run the Download.R script to create the data and output folders, download all required TCGA, GTEx, CPTAC, CCLE, etc. files (≈15 GB, 16 files), and unzip them. Expected duration ≈1 h on a 100 Mbps connection.

steps.title: Run full analysis script (optional)
steps.instruction: Execute the master Analysis.R script to run all analyses sequentially and store results under ~/eIF4F.analysis/eIF4F_output.

steps.title: Initialize library and data
steps.instruction: Create output sub‑directories, set graphic formats, and load/process all downloaded omics data. This step populates twelve global variables and writes them as CSV files under ~/eIF4F.analysis/eIF4F_output/ProcessedData.

substeps.instruction: initialize_dir()   # creates subfolders for each analysis step
initialize_format()   # defines font type, size, orientation
initialize_data()   # wrapper that runs all five data‑initialization functions

steps.title: Copy‑number variation analysis
steps.instruction: Run the CNV analysis wrapper to generate on‑screen results and PDF files in ~/eIF4F.analysis/eIF4F_output/CNV showing stacked bar plots, correlation matrices, and CNV‑ratio boxplots for EIF4F genes across TCGA tumors.

steps.title: Differential expression (DEG) analysis
steps.instruction: Run the DEG analysis wrapper to compute log‑transformed RNA‑seq expression means, RNA ratios, and perform t‑tests; results are saved in ~/eIF4F.analysis/eIF4F_output/DEG as boxplots, violin plots, and ratio plots.

steps.title: Survival analysis
steps.instruction: Run the survival analysis wrapper to produce Kaplan‑Meier curves (top/bottom 20 % expression groups) and univariate Cox‑PH forest plots; outputs are stored in ~/eIF4F.analysis/eIF4F_output/Survival.

steps.title: Principal component analysis
steps.instruction: Run the PCA wrapper to perform principal component analyses on EIF4F expression in GTEx healthy tissues, TCGA primary and metastatic tumors, and combined datasets; results (biplots, scree, cos2 matrices) are saved in ~/eIF4F.analysis/eIF4F_output/PCA.

steps.title: Correlating‑gene (COR) analysis
steps.instruction: Run the COR analysis wrapper to calculate Pearson correlations between each EIF4F subunit and ~58 500 other genes in TCGA lung tumors and GTEx lung tissues, generate Venn diagrams, bar graphs, heatmaps, and pathway‑enrichment dot plots; results go to ~/eIF4F.analysis/eIF4F_output/COR.

steps.title: RNA‑protein correlation analysis
steps.instruction: Run the RNA‑protein correlation wrapper to compute Pearson correlations between RNA‑seq and proteomics data in CCLE and CPTAC LUAD datasets, and produce scatter plots and differential (phospho)protein boxplots; results are stored in ~/eIF4F.analysis/eIF4F_output/RNApro.

steps.title: Proteomics and phosphoproteomics analysis
steps.instruction: Run the proteomics analysis wrapper to assess protein co‑expression and compare (phospho)protein levels across tumor stages in CPTAC LUAD; outputs (scatter plots, stage‑wise boxplots) are saved in ~/eIF4F.analysis/eIF4F_output/proteomics.

description: The package includes one initiation step, and seven major analysis steps. User can execute each analysis step with one exported function that calls a group of internal functions for data process, data analysis and plotting to achieve a set of analyses. This package organizes all functions related to each analysis step together as one R script under ∼/eIF4F.analysis/R (file names in bold, Figure 2E). Although data process, analysis and result plotting functions are set as internal functions, users can access their source code from R scripts and modify the input parameter outside this package for their own usages. The following section explains the definition and organization of each function. The detailed documentation of all (exported and internal) functions within the package is available at the following weblink: https://a3609640.github.io/eIF4F.analysis/reference/index.html. Analysis.R contains ten exported functions in the package to initialize package and to execute all analyses presented in Wu and Wagner (2021).1 Users can simply execute the following command in RStudio to get all analyses performed and results stored under ∼/eIF4F.analysis/eIF4F_output.> source("∼/eIF4F.analysis/Script/Analysis.R")
